description: platformAutomerge stays false: main has no required status checks, so GitHub-native automerge would merge before (or without) CI; Renovate-side automerge waits for every present check to pass.

packageRules.description: Keep routine dependency updates from every manager in one PR
Reject npm releases younger than one day so newly published versions have time to settle before Renovate proposes them.
requirements.txt is owned by the upstream Python implementation and is not maintained in this TypeScript port.
